{{Current events|year=2019|month=10|day=28|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Afghanistan–Pakistan barrier]]
**Three women are killed after [[Afghanistan–Pakistan relations|Afghan and Pakistani forces]] clash in [[Kunar Province]]. [https://www.citynews1130.com/2019/10/28/afghan-official-pakistani-forces-open-fire-killing-3-women/ (CityNews Vancouver)]
*[[Kashmir conflict]]
**Twenty people are injured in a grenade attack in [[Sopore]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-kashmir-eu/india-allows-eu-lawmakers-into-kashmir-in-first-foreign-visit-since-clampdown-idUSKBN1X716L (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in the Maghreb (2002–present)|Maghreb insurgency]]
**[[Pobé Mengao shooting]]
***Gunmen kill 16 people after they refused to help buy them [[ammunition]]. The attack happened in the village of [[Pobé Mengao]] in [[Burkina Faso]]. [https://www.jeuneafrique.com/848805/politique/burkina-faso-au-moins-15-civils-tues-dans-le-nord-du-pays/ (''Jeune Afrique'')]
*[[Bayonne mosque shooting]]
**A gunman opens fire on a [[mosque]] in [[Bayonne]], [[Nouvelle-Aquitaine]], [[France]], wounding two before being detained. The perpetrator is an 84-year-old man who ran for the [[National Rally (France)|National Front]] in the [[2015 French regional elections|2015 regional elections]]. [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/news/2019/10/28/france-mosque-shooting-man-arrested-two-shot-bayonne/ (''The Daily Telegraph'')]
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**An [[improvised explosive device]] detonates in a partially constructed building in [[Bati Kot]], [[Afghanistan]]. The bomb kills two labourers and injures five more, three seriously. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/2019-10/28/c_138509726.htm (Xinhua News Agency)]

;Disasters and accidents
*An explosion kills five people at a petroleum plant in [[Shaanxi]], [[China]]. A further three are missing. [https://www.scmp.com/news/china/society/article/3035190/china-oil-plant-explosion-leaves-five-dead (''South China Morning Post'')]

;Law and crime 
*[[Impeachment inquiry against Donald Trump]]
**[[Charles Kupperman]], [[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]]'s former [[Deputy National Security Advisor (United States)|deputy national security adviser]], defies a [[United States Congress|congressional]] [[subpoena]] to testify before the [[United States House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence|House Permanent Select Committee on Intelligence]] regarding the [[impeachment inquiry against Donald Trump|impeachment inquiry into President Trump]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/28/politics/charles-kupperman-no-show-deposition/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit negotiations]]
**The [[European Union]] agrees to delay the deadline again for a [[Brexit]] deal until January 31, 2020. [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-politics-50205603 (BBC News)]
*[[October 2019 Iraqi protests]]
**The [[Iraq]]i government enacts a curfew in [[Baghdad]] as renewed protests enters its fourth day. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2019/10/iraq-declares-curfew-ongoing-mass-anti-government-poritests-191028134431588.html (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2019 Chilean protests]]
**President [[Sebastián Piñera]] changes eight ministries of his [[Cabinet of Chile|cabinet]], notably with [[Ministry of the Interior and Public Security (Chile)|Interior Minister]] [[Andrés Chadwick]] and [[Ministry of Finance (Chile)|Financial Minister]] [[Felipe Larraín Bascuñán]] being replaced with [[Gonzalo Blumel]] and [[Ignacio Briones]] respectively. New rounds of protests and riots erupt in [[Santiago]] and other cities after the announcement. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-50207883 (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/oct/28/chile-president-sebastian-pinera-replaces-cabinet-protests (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2019 Lebanese protests]]
**Central Bank Governor [[Riad Salame]] says the economy of Lebanon is "days" away from collapsing. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/10/28/middleeast/lebanon-salame-economy-collapse-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Impeachment inquiry against Donald Trump]]
**The [[United States House of Representatives|U.S. House of Representatives]] announces it will vote this week to formalize the [[impeachment inquiry against Donald Trump|impeachment inquiry into President Donald Trump]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/10/28/politics/house-impeachment-procedure-vote/index.html (CNN)]

;Science and technology
*A study by [[Garvan Institute of Medical Research]] in [[Sydney]], and headed by geneticist [[Vanessa Hayes]], pinpoints the [[Okavango delta|Okavango region]] in northern [[Botswana]] as [[Human evolution|the origin of]] [[Homo sapiens|modern humans]]. Other scientists express skepticism at this, particularly at the study's primary evidence coming from [[mitochondrial DNA]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-50210701 (BBC News)] [https://www.theguardian.com/science/2019/oct/28/ancestral-home-of-modern-humans-is-in-botswana-study-finds (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-019-1714-1 (''Nature'')]
